units.source_text: 且说宇治山庄中，因为石山进香作罢，大家很感寂寞。

en.t: Meanwhile, at the Uji villa, the pilgrimage to Ishiyama had been called off, and everyone felt lonely.

units.source_text: 匂亲王派人送来长长的信，备述相思之苦。

en.t: Prince Niou sent a long letter by messenger, setting out in full the anguish of his longing.

units.source_text: 他派人送信，也很不放心，故特选一个全不知情的人，是时方大夫的家臣。

en.t: Even sending a messenger made him uneasy, so he deliberately chose someone who knew nothing of the affair, a retainer of Tokikata no Taifu.

units.source_text: 右近对朋辈说：这是她从前相识的人，最近当了薰大将的随从，上次到宇治来遇到了她，因此依旧互相往还。

en.t: Ukon told the other women that he was an old acquaintance of hers who had recently become one of General Kaoru's attendants, and that after meeting her on his last visit to Uji they had resumed their old contact.

units.source_text: 万事全凭右近说谎。

en.t: Everything depended entirely on Ukon's lies.

units.source_text: 匆匆过了正月。

en.t: The first month passed in a rush.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心中焦灼，然而未便再到宇治相访，但觉长此下去，将活不成。

en.t: Prince Niou was burning with impatience, yet he could not very well go to Uji again, and he felt that if things went on like this he would not survive.

units.source_text: 因此更添烦恼，终日愁叹。

en.t: His distress only deepened, and he spent his days sighing in misery.

units.source_text: 薰大将公事稍暇，照例微行来到宇治。

en.t: When General Kaoru had a little respite from public business, he came quietly to Uji as usual.

units.source_text: 先赴寺中拜佛，命僧众诵经，布施了各种物品，傍晚时分方始悄悄地来到浮舟房中。

en.t: He first went to the temple to worship, had the monks chant sutras, gave offerings of various kinds, and only toward evening slipped quietly into Ukifune's room.

units.source_text: 他虽然是微行，打扮并不十分朴素，头戴乌帽子，身穿常礼服，姿态异常清秀。

en.t: Although he had come incognito, his dress was not especially plain: he wore an eboshi cap and formal everyday robes, and his appearance was extraordinarily refined.

units.source_text: 缓步入室之时，风度特别优雅。

en.t: As he stepped slowly into the room, his bearing was especially graceful.

units.source_text: 浮舟深感无颜相见，对着天空也觉得可耻可怕。

en.t: Ukifune felt deeply that she had no face to meet him, and even under the open sky she felt ashamed and afraid.

units.source_text: 她心中不由地浮现出那个非礼相犯的人的面貌来，想起今天又要逢迎这个男子，但觉痛苦不堪。

en.t: The face of the man who had violated propriety with her rose unbidden in her mind, and when she thought that today she must again receive this other man, the pain was unbearable.

units.source_text: 她想：“匂亲王信中曾说：‘我自从与你相识之后，似觉以前惯见的女子都可厌了。’

en.t: She thought, "Prince Niou once wrote in his letter, 'Since coming to know you, even the women I used to see so often seem hateful to me.'

units.source_text: 听说他此后的确非常困顿，无论哪位夫人的地方都不再去。

en.t: I hear that since then he truly has been in great distress and no longer visits any of his ladies.

units.source_text: 他家里正在忙着祈祷呢。

en.t: His household is said to be busy with prayers for him.

units.source_text: 如果他知道我今天又在接待薰大将，不知又将作何感想。”

en.t: If he knew that I am receiving General Kaoru again today, I wonder what he would think."

units.source_text: 她心中非常痛苦。

en.t: Her heart was in terrible pain.

units.source_text: 但她又想：“这薰大将实在是一表人才，态度含蓄，举止文雅。

en.t: Yet she also thought, "General Kaoru truly is a splendid man, reserved in manner and elegant in conduct.

units.source_text: 在为久不访问做解释时，言语也不太多。

en.t: Even when he explained his long absence, he did not use many words.

units.source_text: 他并不滥用‘相思’‘悲伤’等语，而是巧妙地诉说会少离多之苦。

en.t: He does not overuse words like 'longing' and 'sorrow,' but skillfully speaks of the pain of meeting seldom and being parted often.

units.source_text: 但这却比声泪俱下的千言万语更加使人感动。

en.t: Yet this moves the heart more than a thousand tearful, sobbing words could do.

units.source_text: 这一点正是此人的特性。

en.t: That is precisely the quality that marks this man.

units.source_text: 至于风流优艳方面，固然不及那人，然而讲到忠厚可靠、恒久不变之心，则远胜于那人。

en.t: In charm and romantic brilliance he may not equal that other man, but in sincerity, trustworthiness, and a heart that remains constant, he is far superior.

units.source_text: 我这回意外地对那人发生了爱慕之情，倘被大将知道了，如何得了！

en.t: This time I unexpectedly came to feel affection for that man; if the General were to learn of it, what would become of me?

units.source_text: 那人丧心病狂地想我，而我竟会怜爱他，实在是荒唐之极的轻率行径！

en.t: That man thinks of me almost to the point of madness, and for me to pity and love him in return is an utterly absurd act of recklessness.

units.source_text: 如果大将以我为荡妇而遗弃了我，我就孤苦伶仃，抱恨无穷了。”

en.t: If the General thought me a wanton woman and abandoned me, I would be left alone in misery, with endless regret."

units.source_text: 她深自警惕，满怀愁绪。

en.t: She sternly warned herself, her heart filled with grief.

units.source_text: 薰大将全不知情，看看她的神色，想道：“多时不见，她已变成大人模样，深通人情世故了。

en.t: General Kaoru knew nothing of this; looking at her expression, he thought, "In the long time since I saw her, she has become quite grown-up and deeply aware of the ways of the world.

units.source_text: 住在这寂寞的地方，想必多愁多恨吧。”

en.t: Living in this lonely place, she must surely have many sorrows and resentments."

units.source_text: 他很可怜她，比往日更加殷勤地和她谈话，说道：“我为你新造的屋子即将完工。

en.t: He felt great pity for her and spoke to her more tenderly than usual, saying, "The new house I am building for you is nearly finished.

units.source_text: 前天我曾去察看，地点也在水边，但不像这里那样荒凉，也有樱花可供观赏。

en.t: I went to inspect it the day before yesterday; it is by the water too, but it is not as desolate as this place, and there are cherry blossoms to enjoy.

units.source_text: 离三条宫邸甚近。

en.t: It is also very close to the Sanjo residence.

units.source_text: 你迁居之后，我们自然不再有朝夕相思之苦了。

en.t: After you move there, we will no longer have to suffer the longing that comes morning and evening.

units.source_text: 如果进行顺利，今春可以迁居。”

en.t: If all goes smoothly, you can move there this spring."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“匂亲王昨日来信，也说已为我准备好一个清静的地方。

en.t: Ukifune thought, "Prince Niou's letter yesterday also said that he had prepared a quiet place for me.

units.source_text: 薰大将不知此事，又为我如此打算，实甚可怜。

en.t: General Kaoru knows nothing of this, and yet he is making such plans for me; it is truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 然而我岂有追随匂亲王之理？”

en.t: But how could I possibly have any reason to follow Prince Niou?"

units.source_text: 思量至此，匂亲王的面影浮现在眼前，但觉孽由自作，此身何其不幸，便嘤嘤地啜泣。

en.t: As she thought this far, Prince Niou's image rose before her eyes; feeling that she had brought this sin upon herself and that her life was terribly unhappy, she began to sob softly.

units.source_text: 薰大将安慰她道：“你不要只管闷闷不乐，你精神振作时，我的心情也安乐。

en.t: General Kaoru comforted her, saying, "Do not remain so downcast. When your spirits lift, my heart is at peace too.

units.source_text: 是不是有人在你面前造我的谣？

en.t: Has someone been spreading rumors about me in front of you?

units.source_text: 我倘对你稍有一点冷淡之心，决不会不惜自己身份而远道跋涉来此。”

en.t: If I felt even the slightest coldness toward you, I would never disregard my rank and travel such a long road to come here."

units.source_text: 时在月初，天空挂着眉月一弯，两人来到稍近窗前之处，躺着眺望夜色，各自沉思。

en.t: It was early in the month, and a slender crescent moon hung in the sky; the two moved nearer the window, lay there gazing at the night scene, and each sank into thought.

units.source_text: 男的回忆大女公子，不胜伤逝之情；女的思念今后更添忧患，悲叹自身命薄，两人各有苦衷。

en.t: The man remembered Oigimi and was overcome with grief for the dead; the woman thought of the troubles still to come and lamented her ill-fated life, each of them carrying a private sorrow.

units.source_text: 夜雾笼罩了山峰。

en.t: Night mist enveloped the mountain peaks.

units.source_text: 站立在寒汀上的鹊，由于环境关系，姿态特别美观。

en.t: The magpies standing on the cold riverbank looked especially beautiful because of their surroundings.

units.source_text: 宇治长桥遥遥在望。

en.t: The long bridge of Uji could be seen in the distance.

units.source_text: 川上处处有载柴的船来来去去。

en.t: Upstream, boats loaded with brushwood were coming and going everywhere.

units.source_text: 此种景色都是别处所看不到的，故薰大将每次看到，总是回忆往日情景，似觉就在目前。

en.t: Such scenery could not be seen elsewhere, so whenever General Kaoru saw it, he always remembered scenes from the past and felt as though they were before his eyes.

units.source_text: 即使这个恋人并不肖似大女公子，今天难得相聚，也是深可喜慰的。

en.t: Even if this beloved woman had not resembled Oigimi, the rare chance to be together today would still have brought him deep comfort and joy.

units.source_text: 何况这浮舟酷肖大女公子，毫不逊色，而且渐渐通达人情世故，习惯京都生活，举止态度都很雅驯，薰大将觉得她比以前可爱得多了。

en.t: All the more so because Ukifune closely resembled Oigimi and was in no way inferior to her; she was gradually learning the ways of the world, growing used to life in the capital, and becoming graceful and gentle in manner, so General Kaoru found her far more lovable than before.

units.source_text: 但浮舟满怀忧惧，眼泪时时刻刻想夺眶而出。

en.t: But Ukifune was filled with fear and anxiety, and tears threatened at every moment to spill from her eyes.

units.source_text: 薰大将无法安慰她，赠以诗云：

en.t: Unable to console her, General Kaoru offered her a poem:
